examples.en: I always get up early.
examples.zh: 我總是早起。

examples.en: They always help us.
examples.zh: 他們總是幫助我們。

USUALLY.example: I usually drink tea in the morning.

examples.en: We usually eat at home.
examples.zh: 我們通常在家吃飯。

examples.en: He is usually busy on Mondays.
examples.zh: 他星期一通常很忙。

examples.en: Do you often go there?
examples.zh: 你經常去那裡嗎？

examples.en: She often studies at night.
examples.zh: 她經常在晚上讀書。

examples.en: I will never forget this.
examples.zh: 我永遠不會忘記這個。

examples.en: They never eat meat.
examples.zh: 他們從不吃肉。

FUTURE.example: What is your plan for the future?

examples.en: We hope for a better future.
examples.zh: 我們期盼更美好的未來。

examples.en: In the future, I will live in Taipei.
examples.zh: 未來，我將會住在台北。

examples.en: I am going to a party tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚要去參加派對。

examples.en: Let's eat out tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚出去吃吧。

examples.en: Tonight is the big game.
examples.zh: 今晚有大型比賽。

ACCEPT.example: I will accept the job offer tomorrow.
ACCEPT.exampleZh: 我明天將會接受這份工作邀約。

examples.en: I will accept the job offer tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天將會接受這份工作邀約。

examples.en: You should accept their invitation to the party.
examples.zh: 你應該接受他們對派對的邀請。

REASON.example: What is the reason for your late arrival?

examples.en: What is the reason for your late arrival?
examples.zh: 你遲到的原因是什麼？

examples.en: I must explain the reason to my boss.
examples.zh: 我必須向我的老闆解釋原因。

DECIDE.example: I am going to decide on the date tomorrow.

examples.en: I am going to decide on the date tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我打算明天決定日期。

examples.en: We must decide where to go for our holiday.
examples.zh: 我們必須決定假期要去哪裡。

REFUSE.example: He will probably refuse to sign the contract.
REFUSE.exampleZh: 他或許會拒絕簽署合約。

examples.en: He will probably refuse to sign the contract.
examples.zh: 他或許會拒絕簽署合約。

examples.en: We must not refuse a customer's reasonable request.
examples.zh: 我們絕不能拒絕顧客的合理要求。

EXCUSE.example: He hardly ever makes excuses for his mistakes.
EXCUSE.exampleZh: 他幾乎不為自己的錯誤找藉口。

examples.en: He hardly ever makes excuses for his mistakes.
examples.zh: 他幾乎不為自己的錯誤找藉口。

examples.en: That is not a good excuse for missing the meeting.
examples.zh: 那不是錯過會議的好藉口。

SELDOM.example: We seldom travel abroad during the winter.
SELDOM.exampleZh: 我們冬天很少出國旅遊。

examples.en: We seldom travel abroad during the winter.
examples.zh: 我們冬天很少出國旅遊。

examples.en: She will seldom complain about her heavy workload.
examples.zh: 她很少抱怨她沉重的工作量。

HARDLY.example: I can hardly hear you because it is too noisy.
HARDLY.exampleZh: 我幾乎聽不到你的聲音，因為太吵了。

examples.en: I can hardly hear you because it is too noisy.
examples.zh: 我幾乎聽不到你的聲音，因為太吵了。

examples.en: They hardly ever eat at that expensive restaurant.
examples.zh: 他們幾乎不在那家昂貴的餐廳吃飯。

ABROAD.example: They are going to travel abroad next year.
ABROAD.exampleZh: 他們明年打算出國旅遊。

examples.en: They are going to travel abroad next year.
examples.zh: 他們明年打算出國旅遊。

examples.en: I have never worked abroad before.
examples.zh: 我以前從未在國外工作過。

ATTEND.example: I cannot attend the meeting this afternoon.
ATTEND.exampleZh: 我今天下午無法參加會議。

examples.en: I cannot attend the meeting this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午無法參加會議。

examples.en: We are going to attend a training session next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一打算參加一場訓練課程。

PROBABLY.example: We are probably going to visit Japan next month.
PROBABLY.exampleZh: 我們下個月可能會去日本旅遊。

examples.en: We are probably going to visit Japan next month.
examples.zh: 我們下個月可能會去日本旅遊。

examples.en: He will probably arrive at the office by 9 AM.
examples.zh: 他或許會在早上九點前抵達辦公室。

RESERVE.example: We will reserve a table for four at the restaurant.
RESERVE.exampleZh: 我們將會在餐廳預訂四人桌。

examples.en: We will reserve a table for four at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們將會在餐廳預訂四人桌。

examples.en: You have to reserve a seat in advance.
examples.zh: 你必須事先預訂座位。

REQUIRE.example: The new rules require everyone to wear a uniform.
REQUIRE.exampleZh: 新規定要求每個人穿制服。

examples.en: The new rules require everyone to wear a uniform.
examples.zh: 新規定要求每個人穿制服。

examples.en: This job will require a lot of travel.
examples.zh: 這份工作將會需要大量出差。

examples.en: He is feeling sick today.
examples.zh: 他今天覺得生病了。

examples.en: You should go home if you are sick.
examples.zh: 如果你生病了，你應該回家。

STRAIGHT.example: Go straight and then turn left.

examples.en: Go straight and then turn left.
examples.zh: 直走然後左轉。

examples.en: He usually goes straight home after work.
examples.zh: 他下班後通常直接回家。

examples.en: She has long straight hair.
examples.zh: 她有一頭直長髮。

BITTER.example: This medicine is very bitter, but you have to take it.

examples.en: This medicine is very bitter, but you have to take it.
examples.zh: 這藥很苦，但你必須吃。

examples.en: He never drinks bitter coffee.
examples.zh: 他從不喝苦咖啡。

GARBAGE.example: You must take out the garbage now.
GARBAGE.exampleZh: 你現在必須把垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: You must take out the garbage now.
examples.zh: 你現在必須把垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: Who is going to take out the garbage?
examples.zh: 誰要去倒垃圾？

HABIT.example: Reading before bed is a good habit.

examples.en: Reading before bed is a good habit.
examples.zh: 睡前閱讀是個好習慣。

examples.en: I will try to change this bad habit.
examples.zh: 我會試著改變這個壞習慣。

DIET.example: You should eat a healthy diet.

examples.en: You should eat a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 你應該吃健康的飲食。

examples.en: He will start a new diet next week.
examples.zh: 他下週將開始新的飲食計畫。

HEALTHY.example: We are going to cook a healthy meal.
HEALTHY.exampleZh: 我們打算煮一頓健康的餐點。

examples.en: We are going to cook a healthy meal.
examples.zh: 我們打算煮一頓健康的餐點。

examples.en: You must exercise to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 你必須運動才能保持健康。

ENERGY.example: I have no energy today, so I will rest.
ENERGY.exampleZh: 我今天沒有精力，所以我會休息。

examples.en: I have no energy today, so I will rest.
examples.zh: 我今天沒有精力，所以我會休息。

examples.en: You should sleep more to get more energy.
examples.zh: 你應該多睡覺以獲得更多精力。

AFFORD.example: I cannot afford this car, so I will buy a cheaper one.
AFFORD.exampleZh: 我買不起這輛車，所以我會買便宜一點的。

examples.en: I cannot afford this car, so I will buy a cheaper one.
examples.zh: 我買不起這輛車，所以我會買便宜一點的。

examples.en: You should save money if you want to afford a house.
examples.zh: 如果你想買得起房子，你應該存錢。

CHARGE.example: How much will you charge for this service?
CHARGE.exampleZh: 這項服務你們將收費多少？

examples.en: How much will you charge for this service?
examples.zh: 這項服務你們將收費多少？

examples.en: They usually charge fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 他們通常收費五十元。

UNIFORM.example: You must wear a uniform at school.

examples.en: You must wear a uniform at school.
examples.zh: 你在學校必須穿制服。

examples.en: We are going to buy new uniforms tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天打算買新制服。

STRICT.example: Our boss is always very strict.
STRICT.exampleZh: 我們的老闆總是很嚴格。

examples.en: Our boss is always very strict.
examples.zh: 我們的老闆總是很嚴格。

examples.en: You have to follow these strict rules.
examples.zh: 你必須遵守這些嚴格的規定。

ROUTINE.example: Exercise is always part of my daily routine.
ROUTINE.exampleZh: 運動總是我日常生活的一部分。

examples.en: Exercise is always part of my daily routine.
examples.zh: 運動總是我日常生活的一部分。

examples.en: You should establish a good routine.
examples.zh: 你應該建立良好的生活習慣。

BARGAIN.example: You should bargain with the seller.
BARGAIN.exampleZh: 你應該和賣家討價還價。

examples.en: You should bargain with the seller.
examples.zh: 你應該和賣家討價還價。

examples.en: They often bargain at the night market.
examples.zh: 他們經常在夜市討價還價。

examples.en: This shirt is a real bargain!
examples.zh: 這件襯衫真是個便宜貨！

examples.en: I will buy it because it is a bargain.
examples.zh: 我會買它，因為它很划算。

QUALITY.example: We must improve the quality of our products.
QUALITY.exampleZh: 我們必須提高產品的品質。

examples.en: We must improve the quality of our products.
examples.zh: 我們必須提高產品的品質。

examples.en: This jacket has excellent quality and will last a long time.
examples.zh: 這件外套品質極佳，可以穿很久。
